name: tesy
highlights: Naturally dried on traditional bamboo machans
Zero chemical preservatives or artificial bleach
culinaryUse: Best for crispy rava fry, coastal tfefefehecha, or spicy curry.

name: Dry Bombil
shortDescription: Signature coastal Bombay Duck, naturally sun-dried on traditional sea-breeze scaffolds. Crisp texture with rich umami flavour.
longDescription: Dahanu's famous Sun-Dried Bombil is prepared following generations-old coastal methods. Caught fresh off the Arabian Sea, gently salted and hung on traditional bamboo frames (machans) to dry under the pure coastal sun and sea breeze. Golden-amber in hue, bone-dry yet tender inside when cooked, perfect for crispy rava fry, spicy Bombil masala, or authentic coastal thecha.
highlights: No chemical preservatives or artificial bleach
culinaryUse: Best for crispy fry, Koli style curry, or dry spicy chutney (thecha).

name: Dry Prawns (Medium Sukha Jhinga)
shortDescription: Sweet, savoury sun-dried coastal prawns. Peeled and cleaned with maximum natural sweetness and intense seafood aroma.
longDescription: Medium-sized succulent prawns harvested from Dahanu's intertidal waters, deshelled and naturally solar-dried. These prawns retain their natural pink-orange hue, tender bite, and concentrated maritime sweetness without being overly salty. A staple in coastal Maharashtrian and Konkani households.
highlights: Rich in protein & healthy omega fatty acids
culinaryUse: Ideal for Sukat Bhaji with onions & green chillies, Prawn Pulao, or ground chutney.

name: Dry Surmai (King Fish Steaks)
shortDescription: Thick, meaty cuts of prime Arabian Sea Kingfish. Lightly sea-salted and cured under coastal sun for rich, decadent taste.
longDescription: Surmai (Kingfish) is the crowned royalty of sea fish. Our dry Surmai steaks are sliced from freshly caught, prime-grade fish, cured with pure sea salt, and air-dried carefully. The meat remains dense, flaky, and intensely flavorful. Once soaked in warm water, it reconstitutes wonderfully for authentic coastal curries.
culinaryUse: Rehydrate for 15 mins, shallow fry in spiced coconut oil, or add to tangy tamarind curry.

name: Dry Bangda (Mackerel)
shortDescription: Whole butterflied Dahanu Mackerels, cured with natural rock salt. Robust, deep ocean flavor with satisfying tender flakes.
longDescription: Bangda is treasured for its rich omega-3 oils and bold flavour. Freshly caught mackerels are butterflied down the spine, thoroughly washed in clean sea brine, and sun-dried on clean net platforms. The result is a savory, firm fish that brings warmth and rustic coastal nostalgia to your dining table.
highlights: High natural oil content for juicy texture
culinaryUse: Roast over open flame, shallow fry with red chili masala, or cook in raw mango coconut curry.

name: Dry Mandeli (Golden Anchovy)
shortDescription: Delicate little golden anchovies, sun-crisped to perfection. Crunchy, calcium-rich, and deeply savory with every bite.
longDescription: Dahanu's shallow coastal waters yield the finest small Mandeli (Golden Anchovy). Gently rinsed and dried whole, these small fish become irresistibly crisp when tossed in a pan. They are an exceptional source of natural calcium and phosphorus, beloved across generations.
highlights: Whole small fish, edible bones loaded with calcium
Great accompaniment with rice and dal
culinaryUse: Quick pan fry with turmeric, chili powder and a dash of lemon juice for an irresistible side dish.

name: Dry Tiny Kolambi (Karandi / Baby Shrimps)
shortDescription: Miniature coastal baby shrimps with an explosion of rich seafood flavor. The secret soul of authentic coastal chutneys.
longDescription: Tiny Kolambi (also known as Karandi or Jawla) is a coastal delicacy. Harvested in the early morning nets, carefully sifted, and sun-dried on clean coastal mats. It lends an unmistakable depth of flavor to simple stir-fries, khichdi, and roasted garlic-chilli dry chutneys.
highlights: Sifted multiple times to remove sand and grit
Essential ingredient for coastal dry chutneys
culinaryUse: Dry roast and grind with roasted coconut, garlic and dry red chillies for legendary Karandi Chutney.

name: Dry White Pomfret (Paplet)
shortDescription: Prized whole white pomfret, delicately salted and sun-cured. Melt-in-mouth flaky white fish with refined sweetness.
longDescription: White Pomfret from the pristine coastal waters of Dahanu, butterflied, lightly treated with pure sea salt, and solar-dried to perfection. A luxurious dry seafood experience with minimal bones and delicate flesh.
culinaryUse: Shallow fry with semolina coating or slow-simmer in thick Konkani coconut gravy.

name: Dry Rawas (Indian Salmon)
shortDescription: Thick boneless dry fillets of Indian Salmon. Rich healthy fats, gentle salinity, and hearty meaty texture.
longDescription: Rawas is celebrated for its natural succulence and mild flavor. Our sun-dried Rawas steaks are hand-selected, cleaned, and slowly dehydrated in clean coastal air to preserve its rich healthy oils and tender protein structure.
culinaryUse: Pan fry with ginger-garlic paste and lemon or prepare spicy tomato-onion coastal gravy.
